courses.name: Hip Hop History & Culture
courses.description: Places the rich movement history of hip hop in a larger cultural context. Students will be exposed to the elements of hip hop culture, including graffiti, emceeing and deejaying, in relationship to various urban dance forms influenced by the hip hop movement. Additionally, students will explore hip hop's international presence, theorize its future and create self-choreographed routines.

courses.name: Dance Techniques
courses.description: Intermediate/Advanced level physical practice that sources a range of dance practices relevant to the current dance field in order to expose students to a plurality of techniques as a form of inclusive investigation.
courses.restrictions: Permission of ARHU-School of Theatre, Dance & Performance Studies department

courses.name: Modern Dance III
courses.description: The body as an instrument of expression; techniques for increasing kinesthetic sensitivity.

courses.name: Modern Dance IV

courses.name: Somatics
courses.description: Current ideas and trends in dance technique, with a focus on the incorporation of dance science and somatics into dance training.

courses.name: Dance History & Theory
courses.description: With a primary focus on Western concert dance from the 20th and 21st centuries, this course proposes an understanding of dance as it is situated in historical and cultural contexts. Rather than proposing a canon of "masterworks", this course interrogates choreography and other dance practices from multiple perspectives such as feminist theories, race, gender, and sexuality studies.

courses.name: Dance Education II: Education & Policy
courses.description: Curricula in dance in K-12 settings, classroom management, assessment/grading, and best practices in dance education in public schools. Current research and policy issues are included. This course counts towards teacher certification in the State of Maryland.

courses.description: Discovery and cultivation of the principles and skills of Contact Improvisation dance technique.
courses.restrictions: Permission of ARHU-School of Theatre, Dance & Performance Studies department

courses.name: Contemporary Modern
courses.description: Physical practice that sources postmodern dance influences, endurance training, improvisation, and choreographic composition to present movement practices as a form of investigation.

courses.name: Partnering
courses.description: Elements of contemporary partnering including weight sharing, counter balancing, momentum/leverage, lifting and moving responsively.

courses.name: Laban Movement Analysis
courses.description: Introduction to Rudolf Laban's system of qualitative movement analysis in relation to understanding personal movement style. Application to dance performance, teaching, composition and research.

courses.name: Dance Repertory

courses.name: Seminar in Dance
courses.description: Individual research leading to a presentation with written documentation of the process, serving as a culmination of undergraduate study for dance majors.

courses.name: Project-Based Learning
courses.description: A specific project, is addressed, in dance from the perspectives of the investigator, the creator/choreographer, and the performer. Projects are cross-disciplinary and/or cross-cultural, and may involve both on- and off-campus experiences.
